fallback.title: Something went wrong
fallback.why: We could not complete what you asked for.
fallback.action: Try again in a moment, and contact support if it keeps happening.

unexpected_error_01.title: Something unexpected happened
unexpected_error_01.why: The application met a problem it did not expect, and nothing was lost.
unexpected_error_01.action: Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.

service_failure_01.title: This part of the application is not answering
service_failure_01.why: The service that holds this information did not reply in time.
service_failure_01.action: Wait a moment and try again.

invalid_input_01.title: Some information needs a second look
invalid_input_01.why: One or more of the values you entered cannot be accepted as they are.
invalid_input_01.action: Check the highlighted fields and correct them.

site_close_01.title: This site still has stock
site_close_01.why: A site can only be closed once all its stock has been moved or used.

no_company.title: No company selected
no_company.why: This request did not say which company it is for.
no_company.action: Choose a company and try again.

no_user.title: You are not signed in
no_user.why: This request does not come from a known user.

no_policy.title: Access is not set up
no_policy.why: No rule gives you rights on this item yet.
no_policy.action: Ask an administrator to give you access.

policy_denied.title: You do not have access
policy_denied.why: Your rights do not allow this action.
policy_denied.action: Ask an administrator if you need it.

other_company.title: This belongs to another company
other_company.why: You asked for something that is held by a company you are not working in.
other_company.action: Switch to the right company and try again.

platform_route_01.title: This page does not exist
platform_route_01.why: The address you asked for is not known to the platform.
platform_route_01.action: Go back and choose another page.

platform_method_01.title: This action is not allowed here
platform_method_01.why: The platform does not accept this kind of request at this address.
platform_method_01.action: Go back and try another action.

platform_request_01.title: The request could not be read
platform_request_01.why: The platform could not understand what was sent.
platform_request_01.action: Check the information and try again.

platform_internal_01.title: The platform met a problem
platform_internal_01.why: Something failed inside the platform, and nothing was lost.
platform_internal_01.action: Try again in a moment, and contact support if it keeps happening.
